acknowledgements.statement: PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 remains the sole human accountable for every assigned capacity and for every decision made while acting in those capacities.
Role labels describe functional responsibilities and review perspectives; they do not imply employees, partners, additional maintainers, or multiple human participants.
All disclosed human capacities are held by the same principal. This overlap is expected and is not a governance violation.
Review performed by PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 in another assigned capacity is self-review and does not satisfy the independent-review requirement.
Qualifying fresh-context AI review supplies independent adversarial evidence but does not replace human accountability or authorize any action.
PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 is a stable public accountability identifier, not legal-identity evidence. The published evidence bundle does not require or claim a legal name.

This assignment record alone cannot make GOV-002 pass. GOV-002 remains BLOCKED until AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 is formally published and approved and the preapproval reviewer-eligibility check reports zero violations.

ai_independent_review.postroot_binding_rule: After candidate-root construction, the final gate must resolve the independent-review role to at least two qualifying fresh-context AI review runs produced under the approved procedure and bound to the exact candidate evidence root.
ai_independent_review.preapproval_binding_rule: This record designates AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 as the future procedural binding. Before candidate-root construction, the independent-review role resolves to that procedure only after the formal procedure artifact is published and approved for its exact hash.

effectivity.activation_condition: The project principal explicitly approves this complete file by its exact SHA-256 after review.
effectivity.determination_rule: Effectivity is determined from external attributable exact-hash principal-approval evidence. This file alone cannot prove that its activation condition occurred.
effectivity.self_hash_rule: This file does not embed its own SHA-256 because doing so would create a circular identity. The external approval evidence must record the computed hash.

overlap_disclosure.overlap_meaning: Every listed human capacity resolves to PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001. No listed capacity represents a different human.

supersession.revision_rule: After effectivity, any content change creates a new immutable revision and requires new exact-hash principal approval; prior approved bytes remain preserved.
